parent_objective: audit metric-selected validation preflight before any full measured rollout
blocked_by: full measured validation must not start until preflight result is audited
preflight reset/config evidence is not actual success evidence
supersedes: direct full measured validation without preflight audit
treating reset-only preflight as measured driving result

public_gates: M2444 must audit M2443 summary, workload rows, reset validation rows, and decision rows
M2444 must verify 350 x 15 source-cell coverage and no duplicate/missing cells
M2444 must verify soft-boundary reset success, unchanged actor observation shape, and zero policy action
M2444 must choose accept, reject, repair, stop, or bounded measured-validation route
M2444 must not run measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2443 preflight evidence admits bounded full metric-selected measured validation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight result audit only; no measured policy rollout, actual success claim, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2443 workload coverage is incomplete
stop if actor observation shape changed
stop if M2443 executed policy action
stop if M2443 is interpreted as measured driving success
fallback_plan: route to bounded full metric-selected measured-validation implementation if M2443 is accepted
route to preflight/config repair if M2443 has fixable gaps
stop for user review if no bounded measured-validation route is supported

admission_evidence: M2443 source cells 5250/5250 with zero duplicate or missing cells
M2443 reset success 350/350 with unchanged actor observation shape
allowed_updates: M2444 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2443 evidence is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2444 audits task metric preflight and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2444; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2443 is not accepted, repair preflight/config support or stop before measured rollout.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits fresh preflight/reset evidence before measured validation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit full measured validation route; cannot itself establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: audit cannot choose measured-validation route, repair, or stop
preflight is interpreted as actual success

hypothesis: Auditing M2443 can accept or reject the metric-selected validation preflight and choose a bounded next route without measured rollout.
success_criteria: M2443 summary and CSV artifacts are audited
preflight evidence is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped
no measured policy rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2444 executes policy action or measured policy rollout
M2444 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2444 treats reset/config preflight as actual success
M2444 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2444 passes if it audits M2443 and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
